en:
Oh, it's you, Shuichi.
Did you want something from me?
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Tenko for a while?
I was thinking of going on a run!
If you're bored, we should do it together!

<CLT=cltMIND>Tenko and I went on a run
through the courtyard.
<CLT=cltMIND>Tenko and I grew a little closer today.
